For each exam, produce a summary table with columns "Rank Range" and "Count", then display the results from both exams side by side in a single table (column names: Rank Range, 1st Diagnostic Exam Headcount, Midterm Joint Exam Headcount), sorted in ascending order by Rank Range. If a segment has no students, record the count as 0. Finally, append a "Total" row summing the corresponding data.
